Title: Public preview: Aspire dashboard support in Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
Azure Container Apps now supports .NET 8’s Aspire dashboard in public preview so you can access live data about your project and containers in the cloud to evaluate the performance of your applications and debug errors with comprehensive logs, metrics, traces, and more.  

Learn more.
